Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 54, "heading": "I COMMENCEMENT DU REPOS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u054-r0029", "target": "Мы только что сказали, что она не поправлялась. Напротив, состояние её, казалось, ухудшалось с каждой неделей. Эта горсть снега, приложенная к голой коже между лопатками, вызвала внезапное прекращение потоотделения, вслед за которым болезнь, таившаяся в ней уже несколько лет, наконец бурно проявилась. В ту пору начинали следовать в изучении и лечении грудных болезней прекрасным указаниям Лаэннека. Врач выслушал Фантину и покачал головой.", "source_sha256": "9a0a0a850882ca4ec69ed9cc04521a7b2550bc82f41d24b918fb551fa4b43af9", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u054-r0029", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "2596558e55eaa4c7a90698e147c6d1ac4892a2786a02bd0d44949dc2c6466a2f"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u054-r0030", "target": "Господин Мадлен сказал врачу:", "source_sha256": "653757052b5245b0c13c0e0b078df57aef8acfc69045e1c1baf0be48f75d97c2", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u054-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "29928057adeab09cf514a40066d3b3009f03d5b6dd47f9d05d01237ad22b55e2"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 1, "book": 6, "chapter": 1, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u054-r0031", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh bien ?", "sha256": "4950a516c968f0619fb8b95afe126297c80c72d6fe6348e65ea081818635e18f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "— N’a-t-elle pas un enfant qu’elle désire voir ? dit le médecin.", "sha256": "b472835895048cbb8c79da6c9567b2545b5202683ae9d646f7c1600f1e2df6e1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui.", "sha256": "9f4a2e0ce3c8b67038a54bfa044334c55d6f083e8cb634d6147afc7307b16a6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh bien, hâtez-vous de le faire venir.", "sha256": "5e67701c9e1893fe61c5c693e37bfecccf5c841ac113b9ac64fe08ff353f1fbc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "M. Madeleine eut un tressaillement.", "sha256": "3a7e6d397e7b72b8ae8e1882606bd51466bd641080d27e9ba6f8d2854cb16506", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fantine lui demanda :", "sha256": "efa350ca985b7e447a5efdc997ef904ab9c7a24fb00fc03729d6c1f24567b097", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qu’a dit le médecin ?", "sha256": "8045e60645f2693286cb0141624904e0432c108f2a1fbb57a9c59d52982ca5ba", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "M. Madeleine s’efforça de sourire.", "sha256": "c72bb75a0abc5267093e6b83d2f9b9d56b5598566d204aefc55e50f32fae20d3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il a dit de faire venir bien vite votre enfant. Que cela vous rendra la santé.", "sha256": "280e3366a69361d51fe254a0c82f5c8af86b840893b9ef704101d2b4a11569d1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oh ! reprit-elle, il a raison ! Mais qu’est-ce qu’ils ont donc ces Thénardier à me garder ma Cosette ! Oh ! elle va venir. Voici enfin que je vois le bonheur tout près de moi !", "sha256": "1b4b2dbfaac825e2121c6c15d2fe8fdfb6058bd81bf523fd78ad6af6d4ba4175", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le Thénardier cependant ne « lâchait pas l’enfant » et donnait cent mauvaises raisons. Cosette était un peu souffrante pour se mettre en route l’hiver. Et puis il y avait un reste de petites dettes criardes dans le pays dont il rassemblait les factures, etc., etc.", "sha256": "50c49334d2cf2630c9290731fddb681cef0d00fef80a46749d3e329169b1d768", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "— J’enverrai quelqu’un chercher Cosette, dit le père Madeleine. S’il le faut, j’irai moi-même.", "sha256": "9c8ac9a68e3bb491fd611854a6032a13b93246b1be7e84aa23cf37448a74808f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il écrivit sous la dictée de Fantine cette lettre qu’il lui fit signer :", "sha256": "3da7db9230aafbce3e068da263870ca6c3dc5727ca13c4cb4f090ebc98e5a245", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0044", "tag": "display_group", "text": "« Monsieur Thénardier,", "sha256": "e9b0d8de5ba9f56ecbf7d79708b62e0e0611ed8176ff69602ebf562bfe3871d8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "« Vous remettrez Cosette à la personne.", "sha256": "c659981b33e5396cebce6ff7daf63053479494a4aaa2d61d120edfcd97a61329", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "« On vous payera toutes les petites choses.", "sha256": "b86354823bc5af62807e7af34197cc60926c7869cbcd27f3d98938e1de2b89fa", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "« J’ai l’honneur de vous saluer avec considération.", "sha256": "b676af46bacab5a6a084841716f7e116d857ed1441735b7783edb41c00c37131", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0048", "tag": "display_group", "text": "« Fantine. »", "sha256": "dba2e081d08ee2ca47043e899721d48c2bd53f58acf53e32a416561c9b1ba080", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u054-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "Sur ces entrefaites, il survint un grave incident. Nous avons beau tailler de notre mieux le bloc mystérieux dont notre vie est faite, la veine noire de la destinée y reparaît toujours.", "sha256": "7748ffa3c3b75d6996c8edf86c7bf8b0f702cd4bf8c1f678aa9be480edc507eb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
